name: ChartQAPro
intro: ChartQAPro 是面向真实复杂图表的图表问答基准，包含来自 99 个在线来源的 1,341 张图表和 1,948 道经人工复核的问题，覆盖推理、对话、选择、假设、事实核验和不可回答场景。
org: York University, Mila, QCRI, NTU, Salesforce Research
build_method: WebCharts 157 网站种子经 Google 图片、二分类 ViT 和人工筛选得到 41,000 候选，选出 800 张图表并另行整理 200 张信息图；与其他来源合并为最终 99 来源的 1,341 张图表，再经九人问答创建、多 VLM 辅助扩展和交叉复核
metric: Enhanced Relaxed Accuracy（精确匹配、5%数值容差、ANLS）
eval_feature: 真实图表多样性, 图表-段落联合理解, 多题型, 不可回答问题
build_method_en: WebCharts uses a 157-website seed, Google Images, a binary ViT, and manual filtering to form a 41,000-image pool, then selects 800 charts and separately curates 200 infographics; these and other sources form the final 1,341-chart, 99-source release before nine-annotator QA creation, multi-VLM expansion, and cross-review
eval_feature_en: Real-world Chart Diversity, Chart-text Reasoning, Multiple QA Types, Unanswerable Questions
intro_en: ChartQAPro evaluates question answering over complex real-world charts. It contains 1,341 charts from 99 online sources and 1,948 human-reviewed questions spanning reasoning, conversational, multiple-choice, hypothetical, fact-checking, and unanswerable settings.
metric_en: Enhanced Relaxed Accuracy (Exact Match, 5% Numeric Tolerance, ANLS)

drawio_review_note: Aligned with ChartQAPro, Findings of ACL 2025, §3.1, Figure 3, Appendix A.1, and Appendix A.6. The final ACL paper is the primary construction contract; official repository snapshot 4b422c6 and Hugging Face dataset revision e27c287 were inspected as supporting artifacts. Appendix A.1 describes the WebCharts discovery scope: a 157-website seed from Hoque and Agrawala is expanded through Google Images queries, a binary ViT isolates charts, remaining non-chart images are manually removed to form a 41,000-image pool, 800 charts are selected, and 200 infographics are separately hand-curated. This is a WebCharts source-subset construction chain, whereas the final release scope spans 99 online sources and contains 1,341 charts plus 1,948 questions. URL, alt-text, and context metadata are retained. Nine creators split five reasoning versus four other-category roles, write seeds, and use GPT-4o, Gemini, and Claude; each model generates five pairs per chart, with further interactive expansion and human removal or revision of simple, unclear, ambiguous, or incorrect items. Seven cross-category reviewers (five factoid and two other-category) compare answers with the original creators; 66.17% initial agreement is resolved collaboratively, allowing under-1-percent differences only for subjective estimates. Evaluation covers 21 models under Direct, CoT, and PoT prompting and uses exact match for multiple-choice, fact-checking, and years; 5-percent relative tolerance for other numbers; and ANLS for text.
